facts_used: Envelope requires payload bytes, payloadType string, and one-or-more signatures
Each Signature requires sig; keyid is an optional unauthenticated hint
Signature input is PAE(payloadType,payload), binding type and exact payload bytes
DSSE scope covers signing/verification protocol plus envelope structure
Key management/PKI is outside the core DSSE scope
Statement v1 uses _type, subject, predicateType and predicate
subject is an array of ResourceDescriptor objects and each subject has digest set
predicateType identifies the predicate schema; predicate carries type-specific metadata

dsse_minimum.payload: Exact serialized evidence Statement bytes; JSON envelope encodes these bytes as base64.
dsse_minimum.payloadType: Unambiguous type string; together with payload it is authenticated by DSSE PAE.
dsse_minimum.signatures: One or more signatures over PAE(type,payload); sig is required, keyid is optional and unauthenticated.

in_toto_statement_minimum.subject: Required set of attested artifact descriptors; digest binds the statement to immutable subject content.
in_toto_statement_minimum.predicateType: Required URI identifying the evidence predicate schema.
in_toto_statement_minimum.predicate: Extensible type-specific object. For this route it must explicitly carry observation, inference, uncertainty, source identity/reference material and replay inputs because the core Statement schema does not define those scientist-agent fields.

observation.replay_property: Because DSSE authenticates the exact serialized payload bytes rather than a canonicalized semantic JSON object, replay must preserve the exact payload byte string (or independently re-create identical bytes) plus payloadType; semantic reserialization alone is not guaranteed to preserve a signature.
observation.core_gap: Neither DSSE nor the generic Statement layer by itself defines a scientist-agent completeness schema, trust root/PKI, freshness/replay policy, or proof that a signer/verifier actually executed. Those remain separate unresolved requirements.

bounded_slice.inference: DSSE plus an in-toto Statement is structurally sufficient as an evidence-package carrier: DSSE can bind the type and exact Statement bytes, while Statement.subject binds claims to artifact digests and predicateType/predicate can carry a purpose-built scientist-agent evidence schema. It is not by itself sufficient to prove complete observation/inference/uncertainty/source/replay capture or trustworthy authenticity: completeness depends on the predicate schema and validation rules, while authentication depends on unresolved signing/key/trust/verification machinery. Therefore this leaf establishes container-level package preservation potential, not an end-to-end signed evidence-handoff pass.
bounded_slice.uncertainty: Actual key generation/signing/verification, key distribution and trust roots, freshness/replay-defense policy, exact custom evidence-predicate schema and mandatory-field validation, canonical source-identity representation, interoperability across independent implementations, and behavior under corrupted/tampered envelopes remain unresolved.
bounded_slice.replayability: Strong for exact-byte package replay when payload bytes and payloadType are durably preserved; not yet tested locally and not equivalent to semantic JSON reserialization compatibility.
